A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same tgGBC research work, with complete main text, references, and seven supplementary pages. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection accuracy, inference timing, and pruning ablations in Section 4, plus supplementary experiments including training with tgGBC and 2D detection.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendices A–D, including detection benchmarks, device timings, and ablations.

M1.justification: The classification-score-weighted attention criterion, top-k query selection, and gradual key-pruning procedure in Section 3 are identical. Supplementary adaptations are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same nuScenes 3D detection coverage and supplementary DETR/ConditionalDETR 2D detection evaluations. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical, including ToMe in Tables 2 and 9, unpruned model controls, and the SparseBEV–OPEN comparison in Table 6.

E3.justification: Metrics, model configurations, image resolutions, pruning settings, and timing procedures are unchanged. The OrangePi precision comparisons and supplementary training schedules also match.

E4.justification: The same parameter sensitivity, classification-score ablations, visual examples, query-pruning analysis, full-convergence experiment, and training exploration appear in Section 4.5 and Appendices C–D.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither adds seed counts, repeated-run information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 reports the same pruned ToC3D mAP of 53.43% and decoder time of 39.17 ms in both versions.

T1.justification: The attention equations, pruning definitions, feasibility reasoning, and Appendix B FLOP derivations are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical novelty and contribution claims: zero-shot pruning without retraining or calibration, nearly twofold decoder acceleration, and limited accuracy loss.

C2.justification: Interpretations and applicability boundaries are unchanged, including background-token removal as an explanation for accuracy improvements, query dependencies, and restrictions involving attention-map availability.

D1.justification: Pruning hyperparameters, model configurations, RTX3090 and OrangePi disclosures, training details, and the code repository link are identical. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The same 41 references and research positioning are retained, including discussions of dense versus sparse detection and the applicability of ATS, ToMe, and Zero-TPrune.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 11 March 2025 to v3 dated 29 June 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and document structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–14 retain identical displays, captions, formatting, and placement. Rendered pages match except for the first-page version/date text.

improvement.justification: The main text and complete appendices retain identical scientific content and presentation. The version/date stamp update does not meaningfully affect the paper's evidence, clarity, reproducibility, or overall quality.
